title.en: Chapter 11 — The Iron in the Fire

book_meta.work: The Seven Voyages of Sindbad, from ألف ليلة وليلة
book_meta.author: traditional

sentences.ar: كنا نجدف بإيدينا، والطوف بيبعد عالشط شوي شوي.
sentences.en: We paddled with our hands, and the raft moved away from the shore little by little.

sentences.ar: وفكرنا إنا نجينا.
sentences.en: And we thought we were saved.

sentences.ar: وبعدين شفنا عالشط اتنين تانيين.
sentences.en: And then we saw on the shore two more.

sentences.ar: عملاقين، جايين مع الأعمى، وماسكينه من إيده.
sentences.en: Two giants, coming with the blind one, holding it by the hand.

sentences.ar: ووقفوا عالشط، ورفعوا صخور كبيرة زي البيوت، ورموها علينا.
sentences.en: And they stood on the shore, lifted rocks big as houses, and hurled them at us.

sentences.ar: الصخرة الأولى وقعت جنبنا، والموج قلب نص الطوف.
sentences.en: The first rock fell beside us, and the wave overturned half the raft.

sentences.ar: والتانية ضربت بالنص، وكسرته.
sentences.en: And the second struck the middle, and broke it.

sentences.ar: والتالتة قتلت أكتر اللي كانوا معي.
sentences.en: And the third killed most of those who were with me.

sentences.ar: وصرنا تلاتة، على قطعة خشب، وبنجدف بكل روحنا.
sentences.en: And we were three, on a piece of wood, paddling with all our souls.

sentences.ar: لحد ما صاروا العمالقة زغار عالشط، وبعدين اختفوا.
sentences.en: Until the giants were small on the shore, and then vanished.

sentences.ar: ونحنا نبكي على اللي ماتوا، ونشكر الله إنا حيين.
sentences.en: And we wept for those who had died, and thanked God that we were alive.

sentences.ar: الموج رمانا بعد يومين على جزيرة تانية.
sentences.en: The waves threw us after two days onto another island.

sentences.ar: فيها فواكه ومي، فأكلنا وشربنا ونمنا.
sentences.en: It had fruit and water, so we ate and drank and slept.

sentences.ar: وبالليل، سمعت صوت زحف.
sentences.en: And at night, I heard a slithering sound.

sentences.ar: حية، طولها زي السفينة، وسمكها زي البرميل.
sentences.en: A snake, long as a ship, thick as a barrel.

sentences.ar: وقبل ما نتحرك، بلعت واحد من صاحبيّ، وهو نايم.
sentences.en: And before we could move, it swallowed one of my two companions, in his sleep.

sentences.ar: وسمعت عظامه بتنكسر جوا بطنها.
sentences.en: And I heard his bones breaking inside its belly.

sentences.ar: وزحفت الحية للغابة، شبعانة.
sentences.en: And the snake slithered off into the forest, full.

sentences.ar: تاني يوم، طلعنا أنا وصاحبي على شجرة عالية، ونمنا على غصن.
sentences.en: The next day, my companion and I climbed a tall tree, and slept on a branch.

sentences.ar: وبالليل، رجعت الحية.
sentences.en: And at night, the snake came back.

sentences.ar: لفت حول الشجرة، وطلعت، وطلعت، ووصلت لصاحبي، وبلعته.
sentences.en: It wound around the tree, and climbed, and climbed, and reached my companion, and swallowed him.

sentences.ar: وأنا فوقه بغصن، بتفرج، وما بقدر أعمل إشي.
sentences.en: And I above him on a branch, watching, unable to do anything.

sentences.ar: ونزلت الحية، وراحت.
sentences.en: And the snake came down, and went.

sentences.ar: وضليت أنا لحالي، آخر واحد.
sentences.en: And I was left alone, the last one.

sentences.ar: وعرفت إنه بكرا بالليل، دوري.
sentences.en: And I knew that tomorrow night, it was my turn.
